description: Start an A/B test comparing two LLM models for a specific agent. Routes a percentage of traffic to the treatment model and tracks cost, latency, error rate, and quality metrics. The experiment runs until statistical significance is reached or the max duration expires. Do NOT use for one-off model comparisons — use compare_models for static pricing data.

agent_id.description: Agent to run the experiment on

auto_promote.description: Automatically apply the winning model when the experiment completes

primary_metric.description: The primary metric to optimize for (default: cost_per_call)

traffic_pct.description: Percentage of traffic to route to the treatment model (default: 10%)

name: metrx_create_model_experiment
title: Create Model Experiment
